meta.primary_metric: coeff_rmse_basis: coefficient RMSE over Noll 4..11 against the drawn aberration re-expressed in the fitted basis, radians
meta.secondary_metric: coeff_rmse: coefficient RMSE against the drawn panel-normalized vector; both arms carry the same ~0.4x radius-convention offset
meta.limitation: offline Sim2f surrogate (no shot noise), 5 seeds, one AberrationConfig; the ratio is a direction, not a p-value
